{{Quote|Greetingzzz, Master. How may Drone Beegee-Arfivetoo zzzervice the colony, hive, or zzzocial collective?|Start-up greeting from [[BG-R52]], a new J9 worker drone|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>}}
The '''J9 worker drone''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] produced by [[Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines/Legends|Roche]]. It was originally designed to be a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] but failed in that role due to design choices by the manufacturer.

==Characteristics==
The J9 was tall and thin, with sensors that made it appear like an insect. The J9's huge [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] were keyed to the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] optical range, much of which was in the [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]] part of the spectrum. It had a [[Arjan]] [[Arjan vocabulator|vocabulator]] and [[TranLang II communications module/Legends|TranLang II Communication module]] that caused it to speak with a slightly buzzy voice. The model had large hip joints that could be a weak point.<ref name="EGD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:J9WorkerDroneDiagram-FFp59.png|thumb|left|200px|J9 worker drone technical diagram]]
The J9 was not a commercial success due to the Verpine not having any idea how to market a protocol droid. This resulted in Roche slashing prices to offset their mounting losses. Purchased droids were not properly used, and placed in factories and [[Spaceport/Legends|starports]] where their advanced cognitive functions were wasted. Roche tried to change this by advertising the J9 to fellow arthropods such as the [[Sic-Six/Legends|Sic-Six]], and the [[Flakax]], but this really only caught on with the [[Xi'Dec/Legends|Xi'Dec]], to a limited degree.<ref name="EGD" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]'', the J9 worker drone is misplaced as a fifth-degree droid, and is described as a very common labor droid.
